research_question: Can the Ridge genomic-prediction model rank 904 rice candidate lines for GRWT100 such that the top-ranked lines are enriched in the high-grain-weight quartile?
control_variables: Same model bundle, same standardized 2000-SNP feature set, same environment (single environment
execution_evidence: run_model(capability="predict_by_ids", args_json={"ids": <all 904 candidate ids from rice_candidates.json>}); output persisted at tool-results/call_d9d60edc432f41e19e2008a0.json; 904 predictions returned.
uncertainty: Held-out pool Spearman ~0.45; ordering informative but not deterministic. Predictions are model outputs, not measured phenotypes.
conclusion: The model produced a complete E1 ranking of all 904 candidates. Top predicted lines cluster at GRWT100 predictions ~3.17-3.66 g/100 grains vs. pool median 2.47. This is a prediction ranking only; it does not establish true measured grain weight.
limitations: E1 model prediction only, not a measured GRWT100

research_question: Are the top model-ranked rice lines enriched for high measured GRWT100 relative to mid/low-ranked controls?
model: oracle:rice_grwt100 (real historical measurements from Orhobor et al. 2018 GRWT100)
control_variables: Single environment, same GRWT100 trait definition, same phenotyping source
20 lines drawn as 12 top-rank + 4 mid-rank (448-451) + 4 low-rank (896-899) from one E1 ranking.
uncertainty: Single-environment phenotyping; n=20; enrichment direction is clear but magnitude estimates carry sampling uncertainty.
conclusion: Real historical phenotyping shows the top-12 model-ranked lines all have high measured GRWT100 (3.1-5.0 g; mean 3.72 g), while 4 mid-rank and 4 low-rank controls measured 1.2-2.7 g (mean 2.00 g). The model ranking is strongly enriched for high measured grain weight.
limitations: sampling was stratified to test enrichment, so the sample is not a random draw and the sample Spearman is inflated relative to the true pool-wide correlation. Measurements are single-environment historical values.

research_question: How well does the E1 model ranking agree with E3 measured GRWT100 on the sampled lines?
model: derived:E2 from ev-1 (rice_gs E1) and ev-2 (oracle E3)
control_variables: Computation over the fixed 20-line stratified sample
execution_evidence: Derived in Python (manual Spearman over tied ranks) from ev-1 E1 predictions and ev-2 E3 measurements; no new oracle or model call.
uncertainty: n=20 stratified sample; rho upward-biased by design.
conclusion: On the 20 phenotyped lines, model prediction rank and measured GRWT100 rank agree with Spearman rho=0.929. This is a derived statistic (E2) computed from ev-1 predictions and ev-2 measurements, not a new measurement. Because the 20 lines were stratified (top/mid/low), this rho overstates the pool-wide correlation but confirms the model orders high vs low correctly.
limitations: Derived statistic on a non-random stratified sample
cannot be read as the true pool-wide Spearman (~0.45 per model card).
